title: evidence.citation_audit_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs EvidenceAuditAgent to audit the consolidated ResearchMemory for claims lacking citation support. Payload is intentionally minimal: the ResearchMemory and ResearchSpec are read from the Research Store by ref rather than from this payload. EvidenceAuditAgent itself is out of scope for this task -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

research_memory_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchMemory object.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen (possibly revised) ResearchSpec object.
